en: A black and white postcard photograph depicting a small mountain village nestled on a hillside, surrounded by forested mountains. The village has traditional Alpine architecture with stone buildings and a prominent church tower rising above the other structures. Terraced fields or vineyards are visible on the slopes. The caption at the bottom reads: 'Grumes m. 851 (Trento)'. The postcard has a scalloped edge, typical of vintage postcards.
